lines.text: Leo borrowed the library's coolest treasure: The Giant Pop-Up T-Rex Encyclopedia!
Be gentle with this book, Leo, the librarian said. Others are waiting to read it!
Leo read it under the oak tree, but when his dog barked, he ran off and forgot it!
HISSS! The garden sprinkler clicked on, spraying water toward the paper pop-ups!
Leo gasped, sprinted across the lawn, and slid to shield the book with his jacket!
He brought it inside, dried every drop with a soft towel, and checked every dinosaur!
The next morning, Leo returned it promptly with a polite thank you note!
Treating borrowed things with great care builds a golden reputation that lasts!
Be responsible and reliable—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
